name: miadi-session-issue
description: A session that asks gets one GitHub issue, opened from its first prompt, and a comment at each exit with what it did, what it published and its last answer. Ask at launch with MIADI_SESSION_ISSUE (the claudeissue alias), or during the session with /session-issue. A session that does not ask is untouched. Issues go only to a private repository, and every text passes the capture sanitizer first. It reads miadi-session-observability's capture when that plugin is installed, and the transcript when not.
